title: Har Simt Hai Udasi
body:
har simt hai udaasi ujda hua samaa
kya kya na huwe zulm o sitam zer e aasman
<<DIVIDER>>
akbar abbas qasim o shabbir na rahe
namoos e mustafa ka abid hai paasban
har simt hai udaasi...
<<DIVIDER>>
aankhon se khoon hai jaari daadi rangeen hai
goya jhuka hua hai par azm hai jawan
har simt hai udaasi...
<<DIVIDER>>
majdhaar may hai kashti toofan ka zor hai
teeron se phat gaya hai safeene ka baadban
har simt hai udaasi...
<<DIVIDER>>
ujda hai do pahar may shabbir ka chaman
maqtal may reh gaya hai qaimon ka ab dhuan
har simt hai udaasi...
<<DIVIDER>>
oonton se gir rahe hai bacche zameen par
jaane kahan rukega ghareebon ka kaarwan
har simt hai udaasi...
<<DIVIDER>>
kitne ameer aate thay wo mutma'in nazar
jinke raha saron par tayghon ka saayeban
har simt hai udaasi...
